scenes.text: The country with the most time zones isn't Russia. It's France.
France uses twelve time zones, or thirteen if you count its claim in Antarctica.
Russia and the United States have just eleven each.
The secret is France's overseas territories, scattered around the planet.
French Polynesia in the Pacific, Reunion in the Indian Ocean, French Guiana in South America.
Which country did you think had the most?

title: The country with the most time zones isn't Russia 🌍
caption: France uses 12 time zones (13 with its Antarctic claim), more than any other country, thanks to overseas territories around the world. Russia and the USA have 11 each. 🇫🇷
